name: smwmusic-kirby-s-adventure-cute-n-bouncy-yogurt-yard-remix
title: Kirby's Adventure - Cute 'n Bouncy ~ Yogurt Yard (Remix)
description:
Poyo!

Did a take on Yogurt Yard from Kirby's Adventure. Given how much I love the Kirby series, it is surprising that I went this far without doing any song from that franchise.

I love Yogurt Yard. It's definitely my favorite song in Kirby's Adventure and in my top 5 Kirby themes for sure. It's super catchy, upbeat, and "poppy" which is very fitting for the game it's in. Always preferred the cute side of Kirby more than the "dark 'n epic" side of him.

Fun Fact
The first ever remix I ever uploaded (not SNES specifically) was a remix of Sand Canyon 2 from Dreamland 3 (it was bad, but a starting point at least), making this the second Kirby remix I made.


Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. E Major (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D# Major (Dreamland 2 Pitch)
3. F Major (Custom Pitch)
